Match.title: Match
Match.description: A live or upcoming cricket match published by the admin.

title.description: Display title of the cricket match

description.description: Match details, tournament context, or broadcast notes

bannerUrl.description: Uploaded compressed data URI or HTTPS image URL for the match banner

streamLink.description: Raw stream URL, embed code, or webpage link entered by the admin

extractedVideoUrl.description: Captured direct video or embed URL extracted from streamLink

streamType.description: Playback transport mode for the video capture player

status.description: Whether the match appears in Live Now or Upcoming

scheduledTime.description: Optional scheduled start time string for upcoming matches

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who created the match

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was last updated

PopupConfig.title: PopupConfig
PopupConfig.description: Configurable announcement popup shown to visitors on arrival.

enabled.description: Whether the popup is currently active for visitors

description.description: Full-detail multi-line message shown inside the popup

buttonText.description: Call-to-action button label such as Join Telegram or Join Instagram

buttonUrl.description: External destination URL opened when the user taps the action button

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who last updated the popup

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the popup config was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the popup config was last updated

MonetagConfig.title: MonetagConfig
MonetagConfig.description: Timed in-website Monetag ad configuration managed by the admin.

enabled.description: Whether timed Monetag ads are active for visitors

adUrl.description: Monetag Direct Link or SmartLink URL loaded inside the website

intervalMinutes.description: How often the ad triggers in minutes (1 to 60)

displaySeconds.description: Countdown duration in seconds before the in-website ad can be closed (5 to 60)

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who last updated the Monetag config

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Monetag config was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the Monetag config was last updated

DeviceLock.title: DeviceLock
DeviceLock.description: Non-PII public device lock hash preventing admin access from secondary devices.

isLocked.description: Whether the admin panel is locked to a single device

deviceHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the primary admin device token

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lock was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the lock was last updated

AdminSecret.title: AdminSecret
AdminSecret.description: Private admin-only metadata storing bound admin identity and primary device label.

boundAdminUid.description: UID of the bound admin account

boundAdminEmail.description: Email address of the bound admin

deviceLabel.description: Human-readable browser and OS label of the bound primary device

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the primary device was registered

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin

email.description: Verified email address of the admin

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created

/matches/{matchId}.description: Publicly readable live and upcoming cricket matches managed exclusively by verified admins.

/siteConfig/{configId}.description: Singleton site configuration document (id: 'popup') for the arrival announcement popup.

/deviceLocks/{lockId}.description: Non-PII singleton lock document (id: 'primary') holding the SHA-256 hash of the bound primary admin device.

/adminSecrets/{secretId}.description: Strictly private admin-only document (id: 'primaryDevice') containing bound admin PII and device metadata.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Strictly private registry of verified admin UIDs.
